subject: Lexical elements
notes: Rule 3 (cite.py --check 8.3.5 "The COBOL character period, when followed by a space, is a separator" OK 3)). kb/Work PB1394 LANDED (wave 73 group A): SeparatorRule reports a DOT token not followed by a space (or the end of the text) as COBOL2632. A period inside a numeric literal or a PICTURE character-string is part of that token (DECIMALLIT / PIC_STRING), never DOT. Negative: DISPLAY N.DISPLAY M -> COBOL2632 at all four editions (it used to compile and print 005 and 007).
